tex_content.html:
\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch6:6-25

Suppose $(M, g)$ is a Riemannian manifold and $f : M \to \mathbb {R}$ is a smooth local distance function. Prove that $f$ is a Riemannian submersion. \end{exercise}
